title: Chapter 8. How to Understand What Cannot Be Understood

blocks.text: The teacher told his students that the highest knowledge cannot be reached through the mind, the senses, actions, or states of being.
It can only be reached through a heart that has trusted the One who stands above the mind, the senses, and every state of being.
This is the last secret of existence.
The One Who Reveals Himself Beyond Knowledge
There is knowledge that belongs to the mind. There is knowledge that comes through experience. And there is knowledge born from deep reflection.
But above all these kinds of knowledge stands the knowledge of the One who lives beyond matter, beyond the gunas, beyond perception, and even beyond spiritual energy.
This is knowledge of the Supreme. Of what cannot be grasped.
It reveals itself only to those who turn to Him as a Person.
Calling His Name Is the Key to His Heart
There is no doubt: His Name is the bridge between the soul and the Source.
When someone turns to Him not for knowledge, power, wealth, or out of fear, but simply to express love and friendship, He always answers.

He answers each person personally, in his own way: to the sincere, He reveals truth; to the devoted, He gives closeness; to the humble, He gives peace; to the seeker, He shows the way; to the one who loves Him, He gives Himself.
He is one, yes — but not the same for everyone. He is endlessly personal to each soul...
Whoever Finds Him Rises Above the Laws of This World
Such a person still lives in his body, and of course his body still obeys the laws of matter — aging, sickness, change, and death.
But his awareness rises above the body. So his fears disappear, time loses its hold on his mind, the gunas no longer touch him, and his fate becomes clear.
Then the soul understands that all its many lives were just roles, every body a costume, every fate a scene in a great play.
But now it recognizes the Director — the One who quietly holds the threads of every soul in every world.
He is the Director, and we are the actors. But when an actor becomes aware of the Director, listens to Him, and helps Him, their bond turns into friendship. And that friendship lasts forever.
Whoever Has Seen the Source of Everything No Longer Sees Differences

For such a person, no one is a stranger, no one is an enemy, nothing stands apart. He sees everyone as part of one great family, a spark of the same heart, a true brother or sister. He no longer lives for himself, but for the good of all souls. He serves quietly, without seeking anything in return, with a light heart — just as the great sages of the past once served.
Service Is the Highest Law of the Universe

The sun serves through its light, the earth through its patience, the rivers through the life they give, the soul through its love. When a person starts walking the path of serving the Supreme, he stops being small, limited, dependent, and alone.
He becomes a channel for the Love that fills the whole universe.

By learning this path, a person becomes pure, becomes free, and starts to shine. Simply knowing the Path already brings freedom. Simply longing for it already brings grace. Simply saying the Name of the Source already purifies the mind.
His Name is light. His Name is purity. His Name is love. His Name can purify the whole universe.
And when a soul calls Him by name, it becomes His friend. He reveals to it His form, His deeds, His heart, and His endless love.
And so the Path of Dharma comes to its end, and the Path of Love begins.

A soul that has come to know Him becomes part of the eternal world of love. It no longer searches — it has found. It no longer fears — it loves. And its love lasts forever. This is the end of the story of matter. And the beginning of Forever.
